comment: Onboarding was confusing. No clear first step. I almost gave up before I even started using it.
The pricing isn't clear. I couldn't tell what the trial included so I hesitated to add my card.
I didn't trust the product enough to enter payment info. It asked for too much without explaining why. I went and read reviews elsewhere first.
Once I got past the confusing setup it was great, but that onboarding nearly made me leave. Please add confirmation messages.
Had to verify my identity and then my payment separately with no confirmation. I redid it twice and then emailed support.
Unclear pricing made me lose trust. Low trust made me do a bunch of extra checking before committing. Felt like work.
I contacted support during onboarding because nothing confirmed my actions. A simple 'you're all set' would have prevented that ticket.
Almost dropped off. Confusing onboarding plus unclear pricing plus no trust signals. The whole thing felt risky for a new user.
Good product overall. My only complaint is the early experience: trust wasn't established, so I did extra verification before trusting it with payment.
Why is the first-time setup so unclear? I expected a guided path. Instead I clicked around and eventually emailed support.
The combination of vague pricing and identity verification with no explanation made me suspicious. I nearly abandoned signup.
Onboarding confusion led me to contact support, which led me to almost cancel. Clearer steps would reduce both support load and drop-off.
